Name: DeepWoods Warp
Author: dhndmn
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]For those who use a mod like Night Owl Plus to "wake up" where you last left off instead of in your bed, this mod extends that idea to DeepWoods. Now you can fall asleep in level 51 and start the next day at 6am in level 51! But beware that since DeepWoods levels are procedurally generated it won't be the exact same AND you can't backtrack. That means you WILL become lost as soon as you go to the next level. Have a warp totem packed or craft one. There is an option to warp back to level 1, which means you can exit to the woods if you want.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip and place in your mods directory. [/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Configure in the Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Let's you warp back to DeepWoods upon falling asleep. Either the same level you were on or to level 1.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]DeepWoods[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29714]Night Owl Plus[/url] mod inspired me to create this.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]And, of course, the great [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]DeepWoods[/url].[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: DeepWoodsWarp
Manifest.Description: If you last fell asleep inside DeepWoods, this warps you back to the same DeepWoods level instead of your bed.
